# octopusdeploy_approval_rules (Data Source)

Provides information about existing approval rules.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `partial_name` (String) A filter to search by a partial name.
- `skip` (Number) A filter to specify the number of items to skip in the response.
- `space_id` (String) The space ID associated with this approval rule.
- `take` (Number) A filter to specify the number of items to take (or return) in the response.

### Read-Only

- `approval_rules` (Attributes List) A list of approval rules that match the filter(s). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--approval_rules))
- `id` (String) The unique ID for this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--approval_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `approval_rules`

Read-Only:

- `allow_self_approval` (Boolean) Whether the deployment creator may approve their own deployment.
- `approving_team_ids` (List of String) A list of team IDs that are eligible to approve deployments under this rule.
- `approving_user_ids` (List of String) A list of user IDs that are eligible to approve deployments under this rule.
- `description` (String) The description of this approval rule.
- `id` (String) The unique ID for this resource.
- `id_scopes` (Attributes List) A list of ID-based scopes this approval rule applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--approval_rules--id_scopes))
- `is_disabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is disabled.
- `minimum_approvers_required` (Number) The minimum number of approvers required for this approval rule.
- `name` (String) The name of this resource.
- `scoping_strategy` (String) The scoping strategy used by this approval rule. Valid values are `"Tag"` or `"Id"`.
- `space_id` (String) The space ID associated with this approval rule.
- `tag_scopes` (Attributes List) A list of tag-based scopes this approval rule applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--approval_rules--tag_scopes))
- `tenant_approval_strategy` (String) Determines how tenanted deployments are gated by this approval rule. Valid values are `"PerRelease"` or `"PerTenant"`.

<a id="nestedatt--approval_rules--id_scopes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `approval_rules.id_scopes`

Read-Only:

- `environment_ids` (List of String) A list of environment IDs for this scope.
- `project_id` (String) The project ID for this scope.


<a id="nestedatt--approval_rules--tag_scopes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `approval_rules.tag_scopes`

Read-Only:

- `environment_tags` (List of String) A list of environment tags for this scope.
- `project_tags` (List of String) A list of project tags for this scope.
